execution.operationsPerformed: Selected source reads, plain literal authoring/JSON serialization, Git blob/byte/hash binding only.

representation.role_tokens: ROOT/P/T/... are data macros substituted from independent guarded seed paths, not literal wire tokens or fabricated allocator serials.
representation.stamp_macros: $SESSION/$GENERATION stay the same through apply/undo/redo; $EXACT_CURRENT_STAMP is captured immediately before each actual guarded call.
representation.offset_units: PositionDto.text.offset is a UTF16 unit count on a scalar boundary; native EGC checks authorize editing. No JS scalar-index conversion or Intl.Segmenter authority.
representation.canonical_rule: canonical_json strings are independently authored JSON data serialized with sorted keys, compact separators, literal UTF8; no production serializer was run.
representation.retained_bytes: Target-local observation macro: preserve raw u64 string at every checkpoint; query/refusal/cancel equality is exact within the same target. Changed apply/undo/redo values are bounded observations rather than invented portable constants.
representation.status: This versioned file is literal contract data with explicit binding macros, not a public SDK DTO.

setup.profile: Existing standard editable KWDJ prose registration, unchanged default limits, no runtime descriptor extensions or fact updates.
setup.facts: No identity-valued attrs are used. Keep admitted context/facts/profile/registry/build identities exact and unchanged; do not invent a fixed registry/build hash here.
setup.selection_setup: One existing public guarded set_selection from None to the declared directed selection; no private setter. It yields one setup state event, selEpoch1/H0. Establish/ack event checkpoint AFTER setup.
setup.checkpoint_rule: Every execute/query/history event count below is relative to this explicit setup checkpoint. Never count setup as an IME document publication.
setup.history_rule: One isolated request on a fresh empty sealed history; no Typing group, preedit dispatch, prior barrier, hidden second command, snapshot reconcile or acknowledge-save between checkpoints.
setup.reads: Use public state/node/map/events/history queries; preserve native response and handle ownership, release any snapshot after canonical/role assertions. Reads must not change model/history/outbox.

derivation_scope.source_proof: Selected source bytes match Git69 (same tree as39). Literals are independent expected data; actual path execution remains future post-freeze evidence.
derivation_scope.one_event: One document transaction publishes one document event even when multiple primitive operations and normalization repairs form its plan; no separate state event for its selection/marks update.
derivation_scope.history: Undo/redo restore exact historical payload and IDs, directed selection and marks; they advance chronological revision/history epoch, and dirty is conservative true.
derivation_scope.identity: Plain same-mark fragments normalize into the original left Text. Split/insert IDs are private ephemeral roles, not surviving public additions.
derivation_scope.cross_scene: Positive P10 is limited to these same-parent compatible plain paragraph endpoints with the scene fully selected. Different parent/type/attributes are not silently generalized.

purpose: Independent native authority literals for OSR41; unchanged existing isolated InsertText. Runtime implementation and actual conformance begin only after a separate contract commit.
authorship: Adopted and source-verified against Git69 before any41 candidate run. New cancel/marks/negative literals are authored data, not produced by native/WASM/browser output.
